summary: Both round-1 Majors are genuinely closed — verified by re-running the demonstrations: the gate now exits 128 on a git that cannot answer (both git calls, not just the first), and a bare or multi-chart `tools/package-chart.sh` no longer rewrites an already-published tarball. The fix to package-chart.sh introduces the mirror problem: its skip is unconditional on git-tracked-ness, so an uncommitted tarball is never refreshed either, and check 1's stale remedy then walks a developer into permanently publishing a version whose bytes match no committed source state. That skip also has no coverage at all — deleting it leaves the whole gate green.
